violated_contract: A transcription queue SLA expiry does not prove processing failed. Home and episode presentation must keep queued recordings transcribing within a bounded recovery window, and must not offer a summary retry before transcription exists.
canonical_prevention: Share a read-time, nonrenewing presentation bound across conversation and episode readers, preserve explicit terminal failure receipts, and regression-test old write-time stamps, exact expiry, retry suppression and rollback without per-row job reads.
